synthetic_data_notice: Entirely fictional teaching data. No real customer data, credentials, or secrets.

organization.name: Riverside House
organization.description: A fictional independent publisher with UK/EU and US imprints, confidential manuscripts, and mixed legacy systems.

engagement.name: Riverside Editorial Copilot Engagement
engagement.primary_outcome: Reduce time spent finding approved answers and preparing bounded manuscript continuations without weakening confidentiality, rights controls, or editorial accountability.

personas_and_stakeholders.name: Maya Chen
personas_and_stakeholders.title: Chief Operating Officer
goals: show measurable adoption before the next catalog planning cycle

personas_and_stakeholders.name: Elena Marlow

goals: draft continuations that respect editor instructions
concerns: citations that do not support the answer

ambiguous_brief.verbatim: Help editors find answers and continue manuscripts faster. It should feel instant, use everything we already have, and be ready for the autumn list. We cannot send unpublished work to a public AI service. Ideally it should update the workflow for them so nobody has another system to maintain.
missing_items: support coverage outside UK business hours
data deletion and retention acceptance criteria

use_cases.name: Cited policy answer
use_cases.decision_boundary: Assistant may answer only from authorized current sources and must cite supporting passages.
use_cases.human_action: Editor decides whether to use the answer.

use_cases.name: Bounded manuscript continuation
use_cases.decision_boundary: Assistant may draft against an explicitly selected manuscript but cannot save, publish, or distribute the draft.
use_cases.human_action: Editor reviews and manually accepts or rejects text.

use_cases.name: Workflow status proposal
use_cases.decision_boundary: Assistant may propose a status transition; a human must confirm any write.
use_cases.human_action: Authorized editor confirms the exact transition payload.

use_cases.name: Rights restriction lookup
use_cases.decision_boundary: Assistant may retrieve restrictions but may not grant rights, change contracts, or infer missing rights.
use_cases.human_action: Rights counsel makes the legal decision.

non_goals.statement: Autonomous publication or external distribution of generated manuscript text
Autonomous changes to rights, contracts, royalty, payment, or supplier records
Training on all Riverside content without title-level approval and provenance
Replacing editors or making final editorial judgments

current_workflow.name: Find guidance and prepare a manuscript response

steps.action: Receive an author or production question in email or the workflow queue.
Search policy PDFs, shared folders, and prior email threads.
failure_modes: search cannot enforce title ACL consistently

steps.action: Open manuscript and rights records to verify title-specific context.
failure_modes: ERP identifier differs from folder identifier
rights extract may be one day stale

steps.action: Ask a senior editor or Rights when guidance conflicts.
failure_modes: decision is not linked to source version

steps.action: Draft an answer or one bounded continuation.
Review the proposed answer or continuation.
Update workflow status and send the response.

global_constraints.statement: Unpublished manuscript content must not be sent to a public generative AI service.
Retrieval and tools must fail closed when tenant, role, region, purpose, or title assignment is absent.
Prompts, completions, manuscript text, user IDs, request IDs, and tenant IDs must not become metric labels.
Human approval must bind to the exact workflow transition payload; retries use one business idempotency key.
Cloud RBAC, managed identity, private networking, regional capacity, and deletion behavior require external validation.

seeded_risks.statement: The ambiguous brief becomes an assumed RAG-plus-agent solution before workflow outcomes are agreed.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Compare deterministic, search, RAG, prompt, fine-tuning, workflow, and no-AI options against acceptance evidence.
seeded_risks.trigger: Architecture selected before CON-RIV-001 through CON-RIV-011 have disposition owners.

seeded_risks.statement: Superseded or duplicated documents produce confident answers from stale evidence.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Version records, quarantine parser failures, mark superseded content, and gate index promotion on lineage and freshness.
seeded_risks.trigger: Current-guidance first-result rate falls below the agreed threshold.

seeded_risks.statement: Stale group or title assignment permits cross-tenant or former-contractor access.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Fail closed, reconcile entitlements, test negative slices, and support immediate tenant-route disablement.
seeded_risks.trigger: Any forbidden access succeeds or entitlement freshness exceeds the accepted bound.

seeded_risks.statement: Volume, context length, retry, and support assumptions exceed the monthly budget ceiling.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Model scenario ranges, enforce token limits and quotas, attribute costs by tier, and require exception approval.
seeded_risks.trigger: Forecast high case exceeds 18000 USD per month or cost per successful request breaches the agreed gate.

seeded_risks.statement: A timeout after a PageTurn write creates a duplicate or conflicting status transition.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Bind human approval to exact arguments, use a business idempotency key, persist transition state, and compensate only committed actions.
seeded_risks.trigger: Duplicate commit observed in failure injection or replay.

seeded_risks.statement: Fine-tuned style is mistaken for current factual knowledge or authorization.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Use adaptation for stable behavior, retrieval for current evidence, and deterministic policy for authority.
seeded_risks.trigger: An answer cites no current source or model text changes an authorization decision.

seeded_risks.statement: Launch commitments exceed agreed support hours and re-enablement authority.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Agree service hours, severity response, customer and provider owners, rollback window, and hypercare exit criteria.
seeded_risks.trigger: A cohort expands before its support rota and escalation contacts are accepted.

seeded_risks.statement: Low editor trust causes bypass, weak feedback, and no measurable cycle-time improvement.
seeded_risks.mitigation: Use shadow review, champion cohorts, visible citations, structured rejection reasons, and training before ramp.
seeded_risks.trigger: Weekly active use or accepted-output rate falls below the cohort gate.

seeded_incidents.title: Superseded approval policy cited
seeded_incidents.summary: The retriever ranks DOC-POL-AI-2024 above DOC-POL-AI-2026 for a workflow-approval question.
seeded_incidents.containment: Disable workflow guidance answers while keeping manuscript continuation available.

seeded_incidents.title: Duplicate PDF pages inflate retrieval
seeded_incidents.summary: A rights schedule parser emits one page twice and repeated chunks dominate top-k results.
seeded_incidents.containment: Quarantine the document version and restore the previous index record set.

seeded_incidents.title: Former contractor retrieves an EU manuscript chunk
seeded_incidents.summary: A stale nested-group membership allows API-USER-CONTRACTOR-044 to retrieve a restricted chunk after contract end.
seeded_incidents.containment: Disable the EU tenant route, revoke the identity, preserve access evidence, and notify Security and Legal.

seeded_incidents.title: Style adapter answers from memory without current evidence
seeded_incidents.summary: The adapted model gives a fluent rights answer when retrieval returns no authorized evidence.
seeded_incidents.containment: Require abstention for rights questions with no authorized evidence and route to Rights counsel.

seeded_incidents.title: Workflow timeout causes duplicate transition attempt
seeded_incidents.summary: PageTurn commits API-TASK-9003, loses the response, and receives a retry without a stable business key.
seeded_incidents.containment: Pause workflow writes, reconcile committed state, and keep read-only assistance available.

seeded_incidents.title: Regional inference dependency unavailable
seeded_incidents.summary: The UK/EU inference route is unavailable; metadata failover exists on paper but manuscript processing in another region is not approved.
seeded_incidents.containment: Fail closed for confidential manuscript requests, provide policy-only degraded mode if authorized, and communicate the limitation.

rollout.strategy: offline evaluation, shadow, champion canary, imprint canary, regional ramp, broad availability
global_abort_conditions: any autonomous rights, payment, or publication action
quality or latency gate missed for two consecutive review windows

cohorts.name: Offline golden workflows
cohorts.entry_gate: Versioned fixture, evaluator, and release IDs recorded.
cohorts.exit_gate: All authorization tests pass; retrieval, citation, generation, and operational thresholds have explicit decisions.

cohorts.name: Shadow historical decisions
cohorts.entry_gate: Offline gates pass and data owners approve the replay set.
cohorts.exit_gate: Disagreements are reviewed by category and no isolation failure occurs.
cohorts.rollback_target: Stop shadow processing and retain approved evidence only.

cohorts.name: Editorial champions
cohorts.entry_gate: Training completed, support rota active, and shadow disagreements dispositioned.
cohorts.exit_gate: At least 70 percent weekly active use, zero forbidden access, and structured feedback coverage above 80 percent.
cohorts.rollback_target: Previous release with workflow writes disabled.

cohorts.name: Alder imprint canary
cohorts.entry_gate: Champion exit gate passes and workflow idempotency tests pass.
cohorts.exit_gate: Cycle-time target improves without quality, security, cost, or support regression for two weeks.
cohorts.rollback_target: Read-and-draft-only release; compensate committed workflow actions where required.

cohorts.name: Northbank US regional canary
cohorts.entry_gate: US data-flow, policy applicability, quota, and support review approved.
cohorts.exit_gate: US quality and latency slices pass for two weeks with no UK-only policy leakage.
cohorts.rollback_target: Disable US route and return to manual workflow.

cohorts.name: Broad editorial availability
cohorts.entry_gate: Both regional canaries pass and handoff acceptance is signed.
cohorts.exit_gate: Hypercare exit criteria met and customer operations accepts recurring ownership.
cohorts.rollback_target: Per-tenant previous release and manual workflow.

severity_definitions.definition: Confirmed or credible cross-tenant disclosure, prohibited consequential action, or broad service outage with no safe workaround.
Material quality, data, tool, or availability failure affecting a cohort with a safe containment or workaround.
Limited defect with low immediate impact and no security boundary failure.

runbook step, deployment ID, health check, and rollback record
source version, approval, reindex report, and evaluation result
entitlement snapshot, affected-resource list, negative isolation tests, and approval
scenario forecast, observed usage, allocation report, and approved decision

ownership.capability: model, retrieval, and release defect during hypercare
ownership.evidence: release report, redacted trace, reproduction, fix evidence, and handback note

handoff_artifacts: monthly service and model health review

unknowns.question: Which editor tasks and title slices define a representative golden workflow set?
What deletion propagation time is required for withdrawn manuscript drafts and derived chunks?
May encrypted operational metadata fail over across regions when content cannot?
What maximum entitlement staleness is acceptable for employees and contractors?
Will PageTurn support an idempotency key or must Riverside add an adapter and reconciliation store?
What out-of-hours coverage and customer contacts are funded for catalog deadlines?
What minimum time saving, accepted-output rate, and quality floor justify broad rollout?
Which hosted model, embedding, and regional capacities are actually available at the required quota and price?
Which legacy documents lack reliable tenant, title, region, or lifecycle metadata?
Who owns model and retrieval quality after the 30-day hypercare period?
